work_class: new-development / offline provenance ledger (no acceptance run)
title: G6 B1 budget approval-provenance ledger for the 120 frozen e0 output slots (56 dynamic candidates + 64 policy slots, zero approvals)
claim_text: Ledger only. All 120 frozen e0 output slots are enumerated from committed HEAD blobs and partitioned into 56 dynamic candidates and 64 interface/reserved policy slots. Every numeric budget and every approval-identity field is null or not_made, no external owner or derivation record exists, and editing this ledger can never create an approval route.

evidence_policy.pin_bytes_source_note: every pin is hashed from the HEAD blob via git show HEAD:<path>, never from working-tree bytes; dirty or staged pins are rejected by git diff HEAD; untracked or staged-only paths are not HEAD blobs
evidence_policy.related_artifact_check: each related id/path/sha256 triple is frozen in the dedicated test module and compared exactly by validate(); any path spelling, hash, order, duplicate id/path, extra or missing record fails closed as related_artifact_mismatch and is never promoted to a pin. Untracked facts remain bound to SOURCE_HEAD via git show SOURCE_HEAD:<path> and git ls-tree -r --name-only SOURCE_HEAD -- <path>. validate(check_git=True) refuses a missing SOURCE_HEAD or a SOURCE_HEAD that is not an ancestor of HEAD with source_head_missing_or_not_ancestor; show/ls-tree disagreement still fails closed. check_git=False is structural only and skips those object/ancestor probes. later tracking at current HEAD does not promote a related artifact to a pin, owner record, or derivation record

slot_set.partition_rule: a slot is a dynamic candidate exactly when it appears in pin:rhs_references slots; every other frozen slot is a policy slot whose policy_class is its R1 semantic_status

promotion_requirements.rule: A slot may leave blocked or pending_owner_policy only when all of the following hold: (1) decision_ref names an id present in external_owner_records and that record is tracked at HEAD with the pinned sha256; (2) derivation.ref names an id present in external_derivation_records and that record is tracked at HEAD with the pinned sha256; (3) the owner record carries approver, decided_utc and a decision text whose sha256 equals decision_text_digest; (4) the budget triple is finite, non-negative and restated in the owner record; (5) acceptance flags remain false.
external_owner_record_requirements: path tracked at HEAD and pinned by id, path and sha256 in external_owner_records
carries approver, decided_utc, decision_text whose sha256 equals decision_text_digest, and the decision_id
names each slot_id it promotes together with the exact abs/rel/rms triple
attested by the project owner or by the delegated engineering authority named by owner decision D-07

lives outside this slice package: never the ledger, never the dedicated test, never the plan note, and never any file under the coordination directory class validation/coordination/** (see external_record_location_policy)
external_derivation_record_requirements: states the reference quantity, the error decomposition, the propagation method, the applicable domain and the open items
does not use any forbidden provenance class RD-01..RD-12
is pinned by id, path and sha256 in external_derivation_records and tracked at HEAD
what_editing_this_ledger_can_never_do: create an owner record or act as one
change R1 numerical_failed or any retained failure
turn a reserved or interface slot into physical coverage
freeze a same-source contract or close #59, #10, G6 or Full

external_record_location_policy.rule: An external owner or derivation record must be a repository-relative path that is not the ledger, not the dedicated test, not this plan note, and not any path containing a coordination segment, i.e. never validation/coordination/** at any depth and under any directory name. Absolute paths, drive letters and parent-directory traversal are rejected. Every path segment is compared with Unicode casefold (str.casefold, not an ASCII-only lower table) after slash normalization and dot-segment handling (with Windows-equivalent trailing dots/spaces trimmed), so validation/COORDINATION/**, validation/Coordination/**, backslash and dot-segment spellings, and trailing-dot/space Windows equivalents are the same path class as validation/coordination/** on Windows and on Linux alike, and check_git=False is enough to see the rejection. Only whole-segment equality counts: coordinationish, my-coordination and coordination-notes are longer segments and stay a different class. This is a structural path-class rule: no directory name is hard-coded, so a newly created coordination directory is covered the moment it exists.
external_record_location_policy.segment_comparison: Unicode case-folded whole-segment equality after separator unification and dot-segment handling; trailing dots and spaces are trimmed per Windows component semantics; non-segment prefixes such as coordinationish and my-coordination are a different class
external_record_location_policy.frozen_pin_path_comparison: pin id/path/sha256 are compared against the frozen mapping exactly (case-sensitive): a case-variant pin path fails closed instead of resolving differently on Windows and Linux
external_record_location_policy.not_evidence_reason: the pre-repair review, first repair, Cursor post-repair review, incomplete DeepSeek repair2, C1 takeover, budget/frame sequence repair, the independent final review, and this related/SOURCE_HEAD P2 repair are provenance records; all live under the coordination directory class, so none can be cited as an owner or derivation record. Their only role is to be named truthfully and to be structurally inadmissible as promotion evidence.
external_record_location_policy.pins_are_a_different_class: frozen input pins are admitted by pin id, path and sha256 against git HEAD, never by location class; validation/coordination/ds-g6-budget-evidence-20260913-01/audit.json stays a legitimate pinned input while being inadmissible as a promotion record

forbidden_provenance_classes.why: R1 is a zero-tolerance cross-version preservation contract that already failed; its differences are what a new budget would have to explain, so they cannot be the budget.
an unbudgeted candidate-versus-reference observation with no approved tolerance and no domain is a finding to explain, not a tolerance.
a single component of a single step of a single case over 13 of 36 states; back-solving a budget from the difference it is meant to judge is circular.
knowing the order does not determine the error constant, and contact, saturation and stochastic events do not admit the smooth-region bound.
model inputs and generic method material are not per-observable implementation error, calibration certificates or applicable-domain evidence.
an artifact cannot be the evidence for its own promotion; the pre-image would include the field itself.
a non-empty placeholder satisfies the entry's type check while carrying no evidence, which is the exact dishonest unfreeze this ledger exists to refuse.
the parent spec forbids converting flight-control integration thresholds into dynamics-equivalence budgets.
untracked in-flight slices are not committed evidence and their own owner decisions are not made.
forbidden_provenance_classes.authority: git show HEAD:<path>; git diff HEAD

forbidden_provenance_classes.why: aligned means structural comparability only; the diagonal candidate is diagnostic-only and the reference solver internals are unproven.
the synthetic ordering probe was never written, never launched and is declared not evidence.
R1 labels those scalars reserved_not_physical_coverage and interface_metadata; a numeric budget cannot convert them into physical coverage.

loophole_rules.reject_if: approval.state == 'approved' (or any approval claim) without a pinned external owner record
loophole_rules.why: the entry gate is a bare string equality; an unapproved assertion would otherwise satisfy it structurally

loophole_rules.reject_if: derivation.ref or derivation.derivation_class is non-null without a pinned external derivation record
loophole_rules.why: derivation and domain are free-form prose in the entry; words alone are not evidence

loophole_rules.reject_if: frame_datum.frame or frame_datum.datum is non-null without an owner decision recorded in an external owner record
loophole_rules.why: the entry only requires non-empty strings, so a placeholder frame or datum would pass the type check

loophole_rules.reject_if: any slot cites a contract_sha256 whose pre-image is the contract file that contains it
loophole_rules.why: the per-observable contract_sha256 pre-image is undefined, so the field cannot be falsified

non_claims: this ledger invents no budget value, derivation, domain, frame, datum or approval
this ledger does not approve G6, does not freeze a same-source contract and does not close #59, #10, G6 or Full
this ledger does not change R1 numerical_failed or any of its retained failures
this ledger does not infer any owner decision from any trace, test or blocking-reason set
the 64 policy slots are not covered and are not approved; they wait on owner decision D-01
the 41/56 frame and 14/56 datum bindings in the untracked in-flight supplement are not cited here as evidence
